rec.name: Known From / Logo Bar (press & logo strip with marquee or slider)
rec.status: Built — launched (tested internally, documented in Slite)

what.text: A configurable Shopify section ('Known from') that shows a row of press or partner logos, or round/rounded thumbnails with captions, under an optional heading. With more than 5 items it can scroll automatically as an endless marquee or work as a slider with arrows. With 5 or fewer items, or when the style is set to 'None', it renders as a static centered row. The ticket's landing-page field says PDP, and the section is named 'Global'. The final build (ed-cro-bekannt-aus / ed-logo-bar) is a general logo bar that can also be used for category bubbles.

why.text: Showing recognizable media or partner logos transfers the credibility of known brands to the shop (authority and social-proof heuristic). This lowers first-visit skepticism and perceived risk, which matters most for unknown brands or on product pages where the buyer is deciding. The moving marquee adds visual interest without taking up much space. The same layout also works as visual category navigation.

how.text: Create the section file in the theme (ed-cro-bekannt-aus.liquid, based on ed-logo-bar.liquid) and paste in the code. Add one block per logo or image. Each block has an image, an image style (full image or thumbnail), a thumbnail shape (circle or rounded), an optional caption, and an optional link. Then set the section options in the theme editor: heading, colors, spacing, layout width, and the style above 5 items. Marquee mode repeats the item set 12 times and animates it with a CSS keyframe translate. Slider mode loads Swiper 11 from the jsDelivr CDN (CSS and JS) and initializes it with loop, navigation arrows, optional autoplay, and breakpoints. Static mode is the fallback for 5 or fewer items.

items: Section background color (transparent falls back to the theme background)
Heading text, desktop/mobile heading size and bottom margin
Top and bottom spacing (desktop and mobile)
Style above 5 items: Scroll (marquee) / Slides (slider) / None
Per block: image, image style (image vs thumbnail), thumbnail shape (circle vs rounded), caption text, link URL
Open links in a new tab
Item width and gap (desktop and mobile)
Show dots between items, dot size, dot color
Marquee: animation duration (seconds), pause on hover
Slider: slides per view (desktop and mobile), arrow navigation, autoplay on/off, autoplay delay

dependencies.text: No metafields needed. Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme with sections and blocks. The slider mode relies on the external Swiper 11 library from the jsDelivr CDN, which adds a third-party request and could matter for page speed or CSP. The code relies on theme settings (settings.background, settings.text_color) as color fallbacks. Logo images must be uploaded per block. Documentation lives in Slite.

items: Bounce rate and scroll depth to the section
Click-through rate on linked logos or thumbnails (when used as navigation)
Conversion rate for new vs returning visitors
Page load / LCP impact from the Swiper CDN assets
